Heavy storms across South Australia delivered record-breaking August rainfall, significantly boosting metro reservoir levels and triggering spectacular waterfall flows in Morialta Conservation Park.

While the immediate deluge secures urban water supplies, it briefly masks the long-term impact of agricultural dams on historical waterways.
